consequence: ACTIVE_pre(j) = A0+L0 = 6*S_A(j) - paid_so_far >= need_j  <=>  6*S_A(j) >= sum_{KEEP i<=j} need_i  (using IH paid=need at prior KEEPs; L0<2*e_B gives M_B=L0 exactly)

definitions.A-events: StepEv rotation cases from bottom-up splay of x in current A tree (ROOT/ZIG/LL/RR/LR/RL normalized; ZIG-L/R -> ZIG)
definitions.B-events: same for B tree on KEEP accesses; none on DELETE
definitions.S_A(j): total number of A-events with nonempty T7 sites over accesses 1..j INCLUSIVE of access j's A-phase (A-phase precedes B-phase; L0 already includes current A-injection)
definitions.e_B: number of B-events at KEEP j; satisfies (y_j-1)/2 <= e_B <= y_j-1 since each event covers 1-2 rotations and total B-rotations = y_j-1 exactly
definitions.legality: weaker-domain LegalPairInstance: T0 BST over [n], every H key in [n]; all keys 1..n always present (splay preserves key set; DELETE never removes), so e_B=0 <=> y=1 <=> need=0
definitions.need_i: max(y_i-2*a_i,0) for KEEP i; DELETE accesses excluded from the sum
definitions.summation: over ALL KEEP accesses i<=j regardless of Case-A/Case-B classification at i
definitions.y_j: B access cost = depth_B(x)+1 at KEEP j

edge_cases_closed: absent keys impossible in legal histories (would raise); ROOT accesses have e_A=e_B=0, a=y=1, need=0
name: CUMULATIVE_NEEDvsINJECTION (Case-B lemma for MSTL-14, P_all|6|2|FLAT(2))
permitted_premises: REVIEWED LIQ0 facts within exact statements
quantifiers: FOR ALL n>=1, FOR ALL BST T0 over [n], FOR ALL legal histories H, FOR ALL KEEP positions j with L0(j)<2*e_B(j):  6*S_A(j) >= sum_{KEEP i<=j} max(y_i-2*a_i,0)
